about: Beside the estate agent in Varrock with 1,000 coins, Construction step CON1's starter house price. Buy the house from him, then ::tele 2953 3224 to the Rimmington house portal (Home, Build mode, or Enter for the menu).
notes: For the Construction runner scripts (test-runner/examples/construction-*.json) and looking at the house by hand. ::reset takes away a house bought since the first scenario, as the save it puts back had none.
